subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving first completed rides for {Brand}, the rider-side acquisition you scale every quarter. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the completed ride read through a platform-side completion postback, so a cancelled or refunded trip never counts and you pay only for riders who finish a paid trip. At scale we hold around 2,600 completed rides a day in the metros we run. If it helps, I can pull the metro-level completed-ride and repeat-rate view for your live cities. Worth a short look?
register_notes: Stage 1 EN ride_hailing: references prior in S1; restates single proof (completed-ride optimization via S2S completion postback + pay-only-for-finished-trips); one illustrative figure (2,600 completed rides/day, MobUpps); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native US English; no sign-off; X-not-Y avoided.
